originating_goal: Assist the canonical workers toward the first governed StegFin Base trade without introducing non-TV/TVC secrets/tokens or competing with resident runtime authority.

allowed: read-only inspection of canonical heartbeat, resolver and escalation state
validation of whether missing component-resolution executor is an implementation gap or an intentional escalation boundary

release_condition: Release immediately after the escalation/executor interpretation is durably recorded; do not retain a validation claim while waiting for HB30.
